items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select on Base UI Combobox: single value or multiple with chips (Backspace removes), clear, trigger, groups, empty state; selected rows show a filled square bullet (ItemIndicator). IME-safe.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Single: Combobox > ComboboxInputGroup (ComboboxInput, ComboboxClear, ComboboxTrigger) + ComboboxContent > ComboboxEmpty + ComboboxList > ComboboxItem. Multiple: add `multiple` and put ComboboxChips (ComboboxChip + ComboboxChipRemove + ComboboxInput) inside the group via ComboboxValue. Also ComboboxLabel, Group/GroupLabel/Separator, Status, Row, Collection, Backdrop, Arrow, useComboboxFilter. Give each ComboboxChip an aria-label and each ComboboxChipRemove a label naming its value.
